title: Monster Speed V3 Step 2 — Cache-Safe Redeploy
root_cause: Deployment-only Streamlit refreshes repeatedly used comment-only requirements.txt edits. Because GitHub browser/venv cache keys hash requirements.txt, those harmless redeploy markers changed the dependency-file hash and needlessly invalidated dependency and Playwright caches.
patch: Create one canonical deployment-only marker at deploy/streamlit-redeploy.txt, add a permanent diff guard that rejects comment-only requirements.txt edits, prove the marker is excluded from dependency/browser cache keys, and wire an exact Step-2 PR/main proof.

guardrails.reason: Do not mutate requirements.txt during Step 2; preserving its exact blob avoids one more cache invalidation. Historical comments may remain inert. Future comment-only edits are blocked by diff proof.
